But I still see a custom component for the root? I guess because we don't have expressions yet? The expression would resolve most things, to be able to group different ways etc and the expression is necessary for data as layouts to scale is it not?

Well expressions is just data, why invent a language at this time?

No need to rebuild the existing root component, instead we open up the power to look upon data different angles. That is what the reader will become, built upon the substrate of the primitives working through the primitives.

Also, wondering is given and space the right method, anything goes against it and anything in OpenLight that goes against how it is today?

And consider the DX of being in components, the usual field based work ought to be clean, using expressions included.

Sounds like there are various issues in what is design, go ahead and resolve everything and triple check of course, run cycles and agents as much as is needed to settle in nuanced confidence about all angles of the work that may matter.
